definition_en: The ability to help others learn, develop skills, and grow professionally through instruction, guidance, feedback, and coaching.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk membantu orang lain belajar, membangunkan kemahiran dan berkembang secara profesional melalui pengajaran, bimbingan, maklum balas dan latihan.
typical_tasks_en:
• Show a new cashier how to handle returns and watch them practise.
• Coach an intern on how to structure a client email.
• Create a step-by-step guide for using the inventory scanner.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Tunjukkan juruwang baharu cara mengendalikan pemulangan dan perhatikan dia berlatih.
• Bimbing pelatih tentang cara menyusun e-mel pelanggan.
• Cipta panduan langkah demi langkah untuk menggunakan pengimbas inventori.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves training or instructing others in a skill
• The task requires providing feedback to help someone improve
• The task involves coaching or guiding a less experienced colleague
• The task requires designing learning materials or training sessions
• The task involves sharing expertise to develop others' capabilities
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only managing people's work without developing them
• The user delivers information once without follow-up or feedback
• The task requires no adaptation to the learner's needs or level
• The user is simply delegating tasks without teaching how to do them
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task assigns or informs others without developing their skills or checking understanding.

confusions.boundary_rule: Teaching develops skills. Service orientation helps customers.
confusions.example_task: Show a customer how to use the mobile app step by step.
confusions.expected_labels: Teaching and mentoring; Service orientation and customer service

confusions.boundary_rule: Teaching transfers skills to individuals. Talent management plans workforce development.
confusions.example_task: Coach a high-potential employee for a leadership role.

confusions.boundary_rule: Teaching develops capability. Leadership provides direction.
confusions.example_task: Lead a team meeting and then mentor a junior member on presentation skills.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Teaching and mentoring
